title: Science Integration Wave — Measurement, Derivation, Prediction and Cross-Project Application
status: canonical routing/index layer for the September 11 science integration programme
purpose: Route readers from equations to scientific roles, assumptions, measurements, conclusions and canonical owner papers, then propagate those models back into the project's symbolic, ethical, astronomical, archival and philosophical owners. This index prevents the science wing from becoming an isolated collection of equations or side papers.
central_question: What scientific job does each equation perform, how is it measured, what baseline does it compete with, what would make it fail, and what other part of the project becomes more discriminating because of it?
integration_spine: propagate useful result back to non-science canonical owner

new_substance: zero angular momentum with positive energy
wave_2_cross_project_models.major_conclusion: Still center can mean zero collective drift while differentiated internal dynamics remain active; relation-sensitive metrics are required.
Garden versus Farm is strongest as an objective/control/outcome distinction; topology and central activity are insufficient.
Visibility, radiant energy, attention, information, evidence and causality are distinct coordinates.
Physical alignment can and did return a negative sanity-check result without invalidating symbolic correspondences.

wave_3_growth_compression_boundaries.major_conclusion: Proliferation is not generativity. A research Tree needs both distributed descendant capability and recoverable lineage to roots.
Mountain is relevance-preserving compression, not maximal accumulation or maximal brevity. Perspective fails when provenance or decisive distinctions disappear.
Closedness has no fixed moral sign. House versus Shell requires function, selectivity, agency, exit, portability, capability and harm.

new_substance: 29 typed applied equations/measurements/null models with role/domain/boundary metadata
wave_3_growth_compression_boundaries.major_conclusion: The applied equations now have a dedicated registry rather than remaining buried inside prose papers.
The science programme is now a set of reusable discrimination laws, not a set of decorative equations.

substantive_conclusions: The strongest scientific formalizations distinguish coordinates prose had collapsed: compactness/curvature, phase/scale, mean/relative motion, visibility/information, support/autonomy, symbolic/physical North, compression/relevance, boundary/protection/capture.
Science is valuable partly because it permits negative results. A symbolic relation does not need to be physically rescued after an alignment/test fails.
A center is characterized by effects on trajectories, information and durable capability—not by the label center.
Integration without flattening has multiple formal examples: anti-phase order, modular Houses with Doors, Mountain summaries with source descent and distributed Garden capability.

Tree and Mountain form a useful non-inverse pair: Mountain compresses many traces into a relevant representation; Tree expands a rooted/seed state into differentiated descendants. Both transformations must disclose what was lost or changed.
A boundary is neither good nor bad by permeability alone; selective passage, exit, portability, privacy, objective and consequences define the useful state space.
Provenance is becoming a scientific variable in the project: it affects source recoverability, correction propagation and whether abstraction can be audited.
next_science_passes: Run the first empirical repository Tree experiment using actual source/claim/link data.
Benchmark Mountain summaries against raw search and flat-summary baselines.
Apply Garden/Farm counterfactual metrics to one real graph.
Implement the celestial Axis calculator rather than keeping formulas static.
Choose one Spudlight empirical layer and collect data.
Develop Seed/Potato as a minimum generative-state / sufficient-representation model only after Tree/Mountain benchmarks identify what needs preservation.
Choose one UPT descendant for actual phenomenological constraints instead of expanding all field-theory branches simultaneously.
project_integration_rule: Any future science paper should route equations to the appropriate ledger, sources to the source ledger, assumptions to the testing protocol, cross-domain/cross-scale interfaces to the integrated architecture, and useful/negative conclusions back into the non-science canonical owner whose concept was modeled.
